Independently projected exact integer Morse boundaries for each unmatched higher cell, all zero, and inspected source Hasse-DAG acyclicity algorithm and alternative mod-two rank checks. As π2(∨2 S²)=Z² and π3(∨2 S³)=Z², zero attaching degrees suffice for the respective integral wedge homotopy types, not only homology.

value.rationale: The Frucht graph is the canonical small cubic asymmetric graph; its intrinsic closed-ball Čech nerves at adjacent natural thresholds exhibit distinct nontrivial mixed-dimensional sphere-wedge transitions, determined integrally, not merely finite Betti tables. These precise homotopy types are natural benchmark invariants for geometric graph nerves and cannot be read from generic cubic-girth results.

final_claim: The intrinsic Frucht geometric graph Čech nerve is ∨2 S² ∨ ∨2 S³ on 3≤r<4 and ∨2 S³ ∨ S⁴ on 4≤r<5, with all other reduced integral homology zero.
limitations: Reverse-order matching non-equivariant but suffices to establish ordinary integral homotopy; no persistent homology maps asserted.
